let row = |id: &'static str, state: CheckState, label: &'static str, disabled: bool| {
  div()
    .id(id)
    .flex()
    .items_center()
    .gap_2()
    .h(px(28.))
    .child(
      Checkbox::new(format!("{id}-box"), &p)
        .checked(state)
        .disabled(disabled),
    )
    .child(
      treq_ui::text(div(), treq_ui::TextSize::Sm)
        .text_color(if disabled {
          p.muted_foreground
        } else {
          p.foreground
        })
        .child(label),
    )
};
